purpose: break scope into well-defined pieces of work that can be estimated, assigned, tracked and accepted
entry_criteria: The team or teams are known
procedure: Break the deliverables down to work packages by outcome, not by activity, until each can be estimated, assigned to one owner and finished within a few days to a few weeks.
Keep the breakdown complete: the lower levels must add up to the whole scope, including testing, documentation, deployment and handover.
Give each package a definition of done and acceptance criteria, and an identifier that tools and reports use.
Identify dependencies between packages and with other teams, and sequence the work with the riskiest parts first.
Estimate each package (stage 38), and check the totals against the plan and budget.
Place the packages in the tracker under their parent, and keep the breakdown current through change control.
deliverables: work package definitions with acceptance criteria
acceptance_criteria: The lower levels add up to the whole scope
Each package has one owner and a definition of done
Testing and deployment work is included
validation_method: Project manager review with team leads.

validation.check: sum package estimates and compare with the plan total
check each package has an owner, acceptance criteria and a parent

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A reporting feature is broken into packages such as 'export API with tests', 'scheduler with failure alerts', and 'deployment and runbook'; each has an owner and acceptance criteria, and the totals match the plan.
